pairs.subject: design-tokens
pairs.evidence: app/invite/[token]/AcceptForm.tsx:131 The form uses the named type recipes in some places (text-display, text-body, text-meta) but in five places reaches past them to the stock `text-sm` size step and adds its own weight (`font-semibold`, `font-medium`), which is the 'recipes, not ingredients' failure the repo itself counts as five raw-text-size debts.

techniques.evidence: app/invite/[token]/AcceptForm.tsx:131 Uses a raw type-scale step (`text-sm`) plus a hand-picked weight instead of a named text recipe. The same happens at lines 203, 218, 238 and 254. Recipes are used correctly at lines 111, 124, 192 and 235.

app/invite/[token]/AcceptForm.tsx:192 Colours come only from role tokens (ink, steel, coral-ink), and globals.css gives coral-ink a separate dark-theme value. Searching for dark:, useTheme, hex, rgba and style= found nothing in AcceptForm.tsx or page.tsx, so the form never branches on the theme.

app/_components/ui/style-debt.json:2348 This file's raw type sizes are capped at a baseline of 5 by the style-debt ratchet (style-debt.test.ts), so the debt is counted and cannot grow. That is the ratchet the technique asks for, not a permanent warning.
app/invite/[token]/AcceptForm.tsx:111 The loading state is plain static text. Searching both files for transition, animate and motion found nothing that moves.

app/invite/[token]/AcceptForm.tsx:31 The only numeric constants in the scripts are a network timeout and a password-length fallback. No visual token is read from JS, so there is no mirror that could drift.
